subject: Genetics
title: Right Not to Know
description: A quick win: understand Right Not to Know.

hook.text: Your genome reveals Huntington's risk. No cure exists. Would you want to know? Some people emphatically don't.

buildup.text: Predictive genetic tests can reveal diseases decades before symptoms.

discovery.text: Studies show 85% of people at risk for Huntington's decline testing.

twist.text: As genome sequencing becomes routine, incidental findings emerge.

climax.text: The right not to know is a recognized ethical principle.

punchline.text: Sometimes the kindest data is the data you never see.

quiz.question: What percentage of people at risk for Huntington's decline testing?
